title: Pakistan, Unscripted
deck: A creative exhibition exploring Pakistan beyond the familiar — through poetry, prose, visual art, music, film, performance, and the many ways a country can be remembered, questioned, imagined, and reimagined.
author: Author Name
body: An Independence Day Creative Exhibition by SOUL & SCRIPT — Creators Club
This Independence Day, SOUL & SCRIPT invites you to look beyond the familiar and present Pakistan as you see it — as you remember it, question it, celebrate it, criticize it, dream it, or imagine it.

There is no single way to tell the story of a country. Pakistan is more than a flag, a date, or a collection of familiar symbols. It is memory and contradiction, landscape and language, struggle and celebration, history and possibility. This exhibition is an invitation to explore all of it. Write yours. Paint yours. Capture yours. Perform yours. There are no prescribed interpretations. No single Pakistan exists on the page. Tell us yours.
Entries may be submitted in any language.
The winning artist will receive a cash prize of Rs. 2,000.
The winning work will be published in the upcoming SOUL & SCRIPT annual booklet.
The winner will also have the opportunity to appear in the annual journal of SMC — SUVASTU.
Send your work to:soulnscript26@gmail.com
Social Media Reference — Instagram, Pinterest, VSCO, Substack, etc.
A country is never only what is written about it.It is what is remembered.
This Independence Day, tell us the Pakistan that lives beyond the familiar script.
Let your creativity speak beyond the script.
To reveal the hidden artists within.
